csv_project_name: Engrg for Granby Track & Baseball & Softball Fields Replace
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Granby requests proposals from State of Connecticut Licensed Professional Engineers to provide the following: 1) Engineering services in support of the planning, design, and construction of a replacement athletic/running track and adjacent baseball and softball fields at the high school/middle school complex 2) On-call Engineering services including, but not limited to, the construction of a year-round bathroom at Salmon Brook Park, the construction of pickleball courts at Salmon Brook Park, the assessment and administration of a sewer pump maintenance project, and other civil engineering tasks associated with a municipality and its capital infrastructure. The term of the assignment will be five years of task-order, project work. The Town will have sole discretion as to which projects, if any, will be assigned to the Engineering firm.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics

title: Engineering Services for Replacement of Granby Track and Baseball and Softball Fields
short_description: Engineering services for athletic field replacement and municipal on-call civil infrastructure projects.
project_scope: Planning, design, and construction support for replacement of an athletic/running track and adjacent baseball and softball fields at the high school/middle school complex. The procurement also includes five years of on-call task-order engineering services for municipal projects such as a year-round bathroom at Salmon Brook Park, pickleball courts, sewer pump maintenance project assessment and administration, and other civil engineering tasks related to municipal capital infrastructure.
services: Engineering services by Connecticut-licensed professional engineers, including planning, design, and construction support; on-call civil engineering services; requested disciplines include landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, mechanical engineering, and hydrology/hydraulics.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a municipal civil engineering and parks/sports field replacement assignment, not a structural or bridge project.
- Includes athletic track and field works, bathroom, pickleball courts, and sewer pump maintenance rather than complex load-bearing structures.
- Framework-style five-year on-call task-order arrangement with undefined future scope reduces strategic fit.
- No indication of long-span roofs, bridges, stadium structures, or architecturally demanding building structures.
- Some sports-related context exists, but the described works are low structural complexity and therefore of limited relevance to sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. The notice mentions replacement of a running track and adjacent baseball/softball fields plus various on-call municipal projects, but provides no quantities, areas, or budget figures, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The procurement is for engineering services under a five-year task-order arrangement with undefined assignments, so an sbp fee cannot be derived reliably from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Bidders must be State of Connecticut Licensed Professional Engineers. Requested disciplines: landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, mechanical engineering, and hydrology/hydraulics.
contracting_authority: Town of Granby, Granby, CT, USA. Contact: Mike Walsh. Phone: 860-844-5300. Fax: 860-653-4769. Email: mwalsh@granby-ct.gov. Website: https://portal.ct.gov/das/ctsource/bidboard?language=en_US
